comment: Initial values refused (schema 1.9, homecontrol #107): only a datapoint with virtual has one; it is a JSON literal value of the datapoint's type (spec/rules.md 3.1) within the range of that type.

refusals.reason: only a datapoint with virtual has an initial value
not a value of type boolean
not a value of type unsigned
not a value of type signed
not a value of type string
not a value of type timeOfDay
not a value of type raw
